overview.title: Program Overview
overview.description: PCI's Medical Assistant program can train you for a career in healthcare in as little as nine months by teaching essential clinical and administrative skills; the program includes classroom instruction, hands-on lab practice, and a 200-hour externship, and allows students to pursue specializations such as Medical Administrative Office Assistant, Clinic Assistant, Clinic Technical Assistance, Medical Office Management, Phlebotomy, and Physical Therapy Aide.

items.title: Clinical skills
items.description: Check vital signs, assist with physical exams, perform injections and basic clinical procedures.

items.title: Laboratory procedures
items.description: Perform basic lab tests including phlebotomy, urinalysis, microscopy and autoclaving.

items.title: Diagnostic testing
items.description: Conduct EKGs and other common medical diagnostic tests.

items.title: Electronic Health Records
items.description: Training in EHR systems and transcribing patient medical information.

items.title: Administrative office skills
items.description: Schedule and coordinate patient appointments, front office procedures and medical office operations.

items.title: Foundational medical knowledge
items.description: Anatomy and physiology, pharmacology, first aid and CPR instruction.

handsOnTraining.title: Hands-On Training
handsOnTraining.description: Practical lab sessions provide direct experience with clinical procedures and equipment.

items.title: Phlebotomy
items.description: Hands-on practice drawing blood and preparing samples for analysis.

items.title: Injections and injections technique
items.description: Practice administering common injections and safe handling procedures.

items.title: EKG and diagnostic tests
items.description: Perform and interpret basic EKGs and other diagnostic procedures.

items.title: Laboratory techniques
items.description: Urinalysis, microscopy and autoclaving procedures.

externship.title: Externship
externship.description: A 200-hour, real-world externship placed with professional partners to apply clinical and administrative skills.

faq.question: How long does the Medical Assistant program take?
faq.answer: The program can prepare you in as little as nine months.

faq.question: Does the program include practical experience?
faq.answer: Yes. The program includes hands-on lab training and a 200-hour externship.

faq.question: Where is the Medical Assistant program offered?
faq.answer: PCI offers the program at campuses in Richardson, TX and Dallas (Southwest Dallas), TX.

faq.question: Is PCI accredited?
faq.answer: PCI Health Training Center is accredited by the Accrediting Commission of Career Schools and Colleges (ACCSC) and is approved by the Texas Workforce Commission.
